machines.renderProvenance: TraceParts provider-hosted CAD/viewer reference for pilot validation.
machines.licenseNote: Pilot fixture keeps vendor CAD/render assets as provider links only. Verify TraceParts license terms before storing, redistributing, or exporting CAD files.

assemblySteps.title: Confirm actuator source record
assemblySteps.instructions: Verify the source provider, catalog record, stroke class, motor interface, and CAD format availability before adding the actuator to the rebuild package.
assemblySteps.qualityCheck: Provider viewer opens and the catalog record matches the selected actuator family.

assemblySteps.title: Fit motion rail and bracket
assemblySteps.instructions: Compare the linear guide rail, mounting bracket, and fastener kit against the machine scan and selected CAD reference.
assemblySteps.qualityCheck: Rail length, bracket hole pattern, and actuator centerline are ready for CAD review.

assemblySteps.title: Prepare actuator BOM handoff
assemblySteps.instructions: Carry provider record IDs, CAD links, and reviewer notes into the BOM and build sheet without downloading restricted CAD files.
assemblySteps.qualityCheck: BOM lines include source provider, part family, visual evidence source, and reviewer-required license note.
